W pliku CSV podaj kolumny: stimulus_name: Use these CSV columns: stimulus_name (or video_name) — stimulus filename, question — question text, correct_answer — correct answer (yes or no, optional), part — study part (first, second or both). The stimulus filename can refer to a video or image. A missing part column or an empty value means the first part. Participants do not see the correct answer. Loading a file replaces the questions in the editor.
Pierwsza i druga część oznaczają kolejno: First and second refer to display order, regardless of which scale the participant starts with. New questions appear in both parts by default.
Badanie ma jedną część, więc wszystkie p: This study has one part, so all questions appear in that part. Re-enabling both scales restores the previously selected parts for each question.
